summary.intent: Continue the monokl work after the snippets PR: sweep and resolve any open findings, then replace the exact o200k tiktoken-based token counter in budget.rs with a byte-based estimate and drop the dependency.
summary.outcome: The sweep found no open findings on monokl trails, and PR #63 (with the --no-questions gate fix) had merged to main with green CI. On a new branch from main the tokenizer was replaced with an estimate, the dependency and lockfile entries removed, docs/CLI help/changeset/decision log updated, local gates passed (637 tests, 98.14% coverage), output was checked as byte-identical across 15 queries, and the change was committed.

repo: scripts/rg-compare.py has question and identifier gates; a gate with nothing to score (e.g. --no-questions) is now skipped rather than treated as 0%.
The repo's local gate covers lint (including typos), docs, deny, machete, drift and changesets, plus tests and coverage.
Lint/CI runs with --locked, so removing a dependency requires regenerating Cargo.lock first (done offline).
Changes need a changeset file in .changeset/ and an entry in the decision log.
Two tests in budget.rs had hard-coded o200k token counts and had to be restated against the estimate.
README, CLI help text (cli.rs) and spec lines mentioned o200k and had to be updated alongside the code.

code.finding: Token counting moved from the exact o200k tokenizer to a byte-based estimate, calibrated by measuring bytes per token on real search output from the pinned repos. Token tests were rewritten first (TDD, confirmed red) and two hard-coded count tests were restated.
CLI help text referenced the o200k tokenizer and was updated to describe the estimate.

workflow: The first findings sweep script silently skipped changes with empty branches and swallowed errors; make such scripts report every item checked.
The trail list output omits some changes, so fetching each trail directly and filtering to the target repo was more reliable.
Stale state check: change 35 turned to 'merged', so verify PR and main state before assuming work is still pending.
Write tests to the new contract first and confirm they fail before implementing.
Back claims in a changeset or decision record with measurements, and verify refactors that should only change counts by diffing output before and after across a set of queries.

friction: The findings sweep script needed three rewrites: it reported nothing at first, hid errors, and used the wrong list key.
The trail list included other repositories' changes and omitted some monokl changes, adding noise.
--locked blocked the lockfile change and required a separate regeneration step before the gate could pass.
open_items: The release PR #59 was checked for findings and gate status, but the transcript doesn't show the outcome.
The tokenizer-replacement commit is made locally; pushing, opening a PR and CI results are not shown.
The byte-based estimate can drift from true o200k counts, so budget caps are now approximate.
